verdict.rationale: Motion documents its own recurrence feature: users can create daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly tasks, and the AI Task Manager blocks calendar time for them on a regular basis (motion-docs-12, motion-docs-57). That covers recurring human work items, not automated jobs. The AI Workflow Builder (motion-docs-23, motion-docs-64) builds workflows from SOPs, but no evidence shows those workflows can be scheduled to run on a recurrence. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring execution of automated jobs or workflows, recurrence via the API, cron-like trigger configuration, and independent corroboration.
